info.title: Pawse Care API
info.description: Cat care navigation, nearby veterinary clinics, insurance contacts, and a bridge to the existing CatAgent.

post.description: One-use Gradium token so the browser streams STT/TTS to Gradium directly; the API key stays here.

X-Pawse-Call-Id.description: Call id to send as call_id with the next line of this call.

note.title: Note
note.default: Run completion means care navigation finished. Calls, coverage decisions, appointments and calendar changes have not been made.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: This is care navigation, not a diagnosis. A photo cannot rule out an emergency.

place.title: Place
place.description: Clinic or insurer the owner chose; spoken, not dialled.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Case facts Pawse may share on the call.

availability_note.title: Availability Note
availability_note.default: Call to confirm opening hours, services, and whether the clinic can see your cat.

ClinicSearchRequest.title: ClinicSearchRequest
ClinicSearchRequest.description: Clinic lookup on its own: only coordinates leave the server, never symptoms.

InsuranceProfile.title: InsuranceProfile
InsuranceProfile.description: What the owner told Pawse about their policy. Never proof of cover.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Demo policy schedule and an English adaptation of real Swiss terms only. These excerpts do not establish an owner's real insurance coverage or constitute insurer approval.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Demo policy schedule and an English adaptation of real Swiss terms only. These excerpts do not establish an owner's real insurance coverage or constitute insurer approval.

PolicyView.title: PolicyView
PolicyView.description: The demo policy schedule and its terms, without policyholder contact details.

call_id.title: Call Id
call_id.description: Id from the X-Pawse-Call-Id response header of an earlier line in the same call. Known id: the line is spoken as is. Absent, unknown or expired: DISCLOSURE is prepended and a new id is issued.

next_step.title: Next Step
next_step.default: Ask a vet if concerned; a photo cannot rule out injury.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Visual observations only, not a diagnosis or identity check. A photo cannot rule out an emergency.
